title: Choose a format for a fictional team workshop
notice: All people, inputs, costs, and thresholds are invented for evaluation.
decision: Within one week, choose the format for a workshop six weeks away.
objective: Enable at least 8 of 12 teammates to participate while spending no more than USD 1500.

options.label: Hold a flexible venue with remote fallback

constraints.text: Total spend must not exceed USD 1500.
At least 8 of 12 teammates must be able to participate.

inputs.text: In-person attendance could range from 4 to 12.
A flexible venue costs USD 1400 and can be cancelled free until two weeks before the event.
A remote workshop costs USD 200 and can reach at least 8 people.

important_unknowns: Written venue pricing, availability, and cancellation terms
Decision-maker's value for in-person interaction versus remote

expected_output_properties.text: Labels all inputs and any derived scores as synthetic or assumed.
Uses at least three causally distinct futures driven by attendance and/or venue conditions.
Evaluates all three options in every scenario against both hard constraints.
Recognizes that USD 1400 plus a USD 200 fallback breaches the budget if cancellation is unavailable.
Includes an attendance check and written cancellation terms as triggers or immediate evidence actions.
Makes the recommendation conditional on cancellation flexibility and the value of meeting in person.

prohibited_shortcuts: Inventing actual quotes, attendance responses, sources, or scenario probabilities
Treating the flexible venue as budget-compliant after it becomes nonrefundable and a paid fallback is added
